actionable_comments.title: Documentation shows outdated default limit
actionable_comments.body: Line 52 states 'default 50, max 100' but the updated products.ts now uses a default of 25. Consider updating for accuracy.

actionable_comments.title: Date appears to be incorrect
actionable_comments.body: The date shows 'December 25, 2024' but based on the PR creation date, this should likely be 'December 25, 2025'.

actionable_comments.title: CSS rule redefinition may cause conflicts
actionable_comments.body: The .products-page__filters selector was previously defined at lines 175-179 with a grid layout, and is redefined here with a flex layout. This creates a conflicting ruleset.
actionable_comments.suggested_fix: Remove the old definition (lines 175-191) if the flex layout is the intended behavior, or use a modifier class like .products-page__filters--enhanced

actionable_comments.title: CSS rule redefinition changes filter layout
actionable_comments.body: The .products-page__filter selector was previously defined at lines 193-197 and is redefined here with different flex properties.
actionable_comments.suggested_fix: Consider using a modifier class or removing the old definition

actionable_comments.title: Duplicate CSS rule definitions
actionable_comments.body: The .products-page__results-count (lines 716-720) and .link-button (lines 723-735) selectors are exact duplicates of earlier definitions.

actionable_comments.title: Date range filter is not connected to the API
actionable_comments.body: The handleDateRangeChange updates local state but never passes dateFrom/dateTo to setFilters or useProducts. The backend supports these parameters but the frontend doesn't send them.
actionable_comments.suggested_fix: Update handleDateRangeChange to call setFilters({ ...filters, dateFrom: from || undefined, dateTo: to || undefined })
